children: VISA - VISA ACCEPTANCE PLATFORM ENABLES LOCAL E-COMMERCE PROCESSING THROUGH SAUDI ARABIA’S NEW E-COMMERCE PAYMENTS INTERFACE

MERCHANTS AND PAYMENT SERVICE PROVIDERS IN SAUDI ARABIA CAN NOW PROCESS E-COMMERCE TRANSACTIONS LOCALLY AND COMPLIANTLY USING THE VISA ACCEPTANCE PLATFORM, FOLLOWING ITS CERTIFICATION FOR SAUDI CENTRAL BANK’S (SAMA) NEW E-COMMERCE PAYMENTS INTERFACE
Visa Platform Enables Local E-Commerce Processing via Saudi Payments Interface
